name: Greek Pan-Fried Beef Meatballs (Keftedes) with Mint & Parsley

instructions.primary_message: Cut crusts off day-old bread slices, then tear bread into bite-sized pieces. Place in a small bowl, add water, and stir to combine. Set aside to soften, 2-3 minutes. (Discard crusts.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 slice white bread
½ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry parsley and mint. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems and place herbs in a food processor.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
¼ small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and roughly chop onion. Peel garlic. Add both to the food processor.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
2 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the bread is soft, gently squeeze any excess water out using your hands, then add to the food processor. Blend on high until the mixture becomes paste-like, about 1 minute. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Add beef, egg, and spices to the bowl with the bread mixture. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the mixture into meatballs and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb lean ground beef
1 egg
1 tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place flour on another plate. Working one at a time, dredge meatballs in flour and return to the plate.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add meatballs and pan-fry, turning occasionally, until the meatballs are golden on all sides and cooked through, 10-15 minutes. Transfer to a clean paper towel-lined plate.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Arrange meatballs on a serving platter and enjoy!
